The tracker-consistent seed scale follows from the report's identification of seeds with the tracker's void domain; the photon-comoving conversion of [W09]'s 30 h^-1 Mpc is convention-dependent (results given with and without gamma_w0). method: Phase script run on both interpreters (5 s each); results identical up to ulp-level differences in (4.11) residuals and last digits.

su_symbolic.py: exact two-region cell (empty Milne voids V_v=(t-b_v)^3/(tau(1+eps)); dust walls with exact linearised curvature K and bang-time shift b_w); cell averages from [W09] Q1 (line 513) and [GM] (3.12)-(3.13); SU modes as parameter derivatives; symbolic residuals of [GM] (4.9)-(4.11) at k->0 and of the averaged Buchert equations; no use of the report's hand-linearised formulas.
su_combinations.py: exact null spaces of the comoving, Meszaros, literal Delta_eff=0 and barotropic closures over the 4-parameter SU family.

su_numerics.py: closed-form SU ratios; comoving and Meszaros regular growing modes by two independent integrations from closed-form backgrounds (not perturbations.growing_mode); own EH98 no-wiggle T(k) from trans.tex lines 683, 758-759, 776-779, 839-842 with adaptive quadrature; PBS A_v, R*, X_SU; tracker-consistent seed-scale and tracker-f_vi variants; tracker f_v at z=1090.
Primary-source line checks in [GM], [W09], [SvdW04], [JLH13]; own derivation and brute-force check of the EdS tophat-void shell-crossing factor.
Package functions used only for the frozen qplus LCDM growth factor (shared 1G-A normalisation).
No other 1G adversarial audit or auditor scratch directory was read.
